title: DPG L1 Classification Vocabulary
description: Shared classification enumerations for the DPG L1 contract: the determinism (Axis Y) and runtime-dependence (Axis X) axes plus finding severity. Other L1 schemas reference these $defs so the vocabularies live in exactly one place.

AxisYClass.title: AxisYClass
AxisYClass.description: Axis Y — Behavioral Determinism. The canonical determinism classification used across all semantic passes.

AxisYClassCompat.title: AxisYClassCompat
AxisYClassCompat.description: Axis Y with the legacy Sprint-3 alias accepted. Identical to AxisYClass plus the deprecated "fullyDeterministic" literal, which maps to "deterministic". Use AxisYClass for new producers; this compat form exists only where legacy inputs are still accepted.

AxisXClass.title: AxisXClass
AxisXClass.description: Axis X — Runtime Dependence. The runtime-coupling classification used across all semantic passes.
